composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Show Gaara with short red hair, his familiar dark eye outlines, and a plain sand-colored cardigan over a charcoal shirt. Keep his face calm, without an intense frown, and omit decorative forehead writing. Frame him above the elbows with relaxed posture. Use a warm sandy background and separate the dark rear decorations clearly from his clothing and hair. Use flat graphic shapes with one contrasting accent and no dimensional glow. Use crimson patterned irises with visible pupils and highlights. Separate abstract black flame-shaped ribbons float behind the shoulders as decoration, touching or burning nothing and implying no attack. Create an original, nonviolent fan-art avatar, square 1024x1024. Center the character's head and shoulders within 70-75% of the frame, safe for a circular crop. Show both eyes clearly. No text, watermark, weapons, or copied anime composition.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
